<div class="card-body">
'''Death Star: Detention Block Corridor''' is a [[Dark]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">デス・スター：監房ブロック回廊</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配したなら、フォース消耗を＋１できる。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここでは、武器運命数を＋１できる。</span><ref name="jp1-face">Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-284o-Face.jpg|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Death Star: Detention Block Corridor (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text.</ref>
<ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Death-Star-Detention-Block-Corridor-SWCCGcards.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Death Star: Detention Block Corridor.

'''Light Side:''' If you control here, you may add 1 to the Force drain.

'''Dark Side:''' Here you may add 1 to weapon destiny.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese Dark adds 1 to weapon destiny here; English adds 1 to each of your weapon destiny draws here.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Death Star: Detention Block Corridor]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
